name: RSI divergence
idea: A regular RSI divergence between the last two confirmed swings (a lower low with a higher RSI, or a higher high with a lower RSI), then a change of character on smaller swings or a close beyond the confirming bar; the idea is wrong beyond the divergence's extreme.

params.label: RSI period
params.help: Bars the RSI is calculated over.

params.label: Swing size
params.help: Which swings the divergence is read between: 1 is small, 3 the largest. Larger swings need more history.

params.label: Divergence counts for (bars)
params.help: A divergence starts the setup only while its latest swing is at most this many bars old.

params.label: Confirmation
params.help: What confirms the turn after the divergence: a change of character on the smaller swings, or a close beyond the bar that confirmed the divergence's swing.
choice_labels: A change of character on smaller swings
A close beyond the confirming bar

params.label: Smaller swing size
params.help: For the change of character: which smaller swings are read (smaller than the divergence's swings).

params.label: Break distance
params.help: For the change of character: how far beyond the smaller swing the close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: Confirmation within (bars)
params.help: The confirmation must come within this many bars after the divergence was confirmed.

constraints.message: The smaller swing size must be smaller than the divergence's swing size.

setup.long: RsiDivergence("bullish", $divergence_bars, $swing_degree, period=$rsi_period) AND NOT RsiDivergence("bullish", $divergence_bars, $swing_degree, period=$rsi_period)[1]
setup.short: RsiDivergence("bearish", $divergence_bars, $swing_degree, period=$rsi_period) AND NOT RsiDivergence("bearish", $divergence_bars, $swing_degree, period=$rsi_period)[1]
